description.en: Pieverse develops personal AI agents for Web3. Pip, its personal AI agent, helps users research markets, manage assets, and trade onchain through conversations in everyday messaging apps. Pip is powered by Purr-Fect Claw, Pieverse’s platform for creating and customizing AI agents. The platform gives agents access to secure wallets, onchain tools, and skills so they can carry out tasks such as checking balances and transferring assets.
